colliding_names.now: components are ESCAPED before they are joined (`%` -> `%25`, separator `%2F`), which is what makes the mapping injective. Choosing a different literal separator would have moved the collision rather than removed it, because any character a separator can be is one a component can contain.
colliding_names.was: `a/b` and `a__b` both flattened to `a__b` -- three files counted retained, two present, one source's bytes overwritten

end_only.now: it runs from the DRAIN THREAD, which already ticks while the provider runs, and appends only what is new; the final pass adds whatever arrived after the last tick
end_only.was: _retain_native ran in _ran_provider's finally, so a wrapper killed before that copied nothing

silent_truncation.now: bytes stream in bounded chunks; the bound is on MEMORY rather than on the file and nothing is capped away
silent_truncation.was: it read MAX_NATIVE_FILE bytes and counted the file retained, so anything larger was truncated while reported complete

skipped_failures.now: _retain_native answers what it retained and what it could not, and _declare_native puts a retention failure where a reader will meet it -- on provider.stdout, whose turn produced the files
skipped_failures.was: failed reads and writes were skipped and the count was ignored by the caller, so an empty corner read as 'the provider wrote nothing'

toctou.now: every component is opened relative to the descriptor above it with O_NOFOLLOW, so the credential slot is excluded by the open failing rather than by a name check a swap could outrun, and a linked DIRECTORY is not walked out of either
